title: Special agents' blood and urine test results stolen in FBI hack
english: A cyber-criminal group called ShinyHunters claims to have stolen sensitive medical and personal records of thousands of FBI special agents. The leaked data includes blood tests, doctors' notes, home addresses, and badge numbers, which could expose officers to potential blackmail or impersonation. Unlike typical attacks, the hackers are demanding a retraction of a previous FBI advisory rather than financial payment, and the FBI is currently investigating the breach.
amharic: ShinyHunters የተባለ የሳይበር ወንጀለኛ ቡድን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የኤፍቢአይ (FBI) ልዩ ወኪሎች የግል እና የህክምና መረጃዎችን መስረቁን አስታውቋል። የተሰረቀው መረጃ የደም ምርመራ ውጤቶችን፣ የዶክተሮች ማስታወሻዎችን፣ የመኖሪያ አድራሻዎችን እና መታወቂያ ቁጥሮችን የሚያካትት ሲሆን ይህም ወኪሎቹን ለጥቃት ወይም ለስድብ ሊያጋልጥ ይችላል። ወንጀለኞቹ ገንዘብ ከመጠየቅ ይልቅ ኤፍቢአይ ቀደም ብሎ ያወጣውን መግለጫ እንዲሰርዝ እየጠየቁ ሲሆን፣ ኤፍቢአይ በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gochiin yakkamtoota saayibarii 'ShinyHunters' jedhamu, odeeffannoo fayyaa fi kan dhuunfaa qondaaltoota FBI kumaatamaa ta'an hacaatii godhee akka hatu beeksiseera. Odeeffannoon hatame kun bu'aa qorannoo dhiigaa, yaada ogeessota fayyaa, teessoo mana jireenyaa fi lakkoofsa waraqaa eenyummaa kan of keessatti qabatu ta'ee, kunis qondaaltoota kana yakka ykn qolachuu (blackmail)f saaxiluu danda'a. Yakkamtootni kunneen maallaqa osoo hin ta'in, FBI ibsa kanaan dura baase akka haqee fi gaafataa jiran yoo ta'u, FBI'n amma dhimma kana irratti qorannoo gaggeessaa jira.

title: Supreme Court allows Trump to use controversial database to check voter citizenship
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has overturned a lower court ruling, permitting the Trump administration to use a federal database to verify the citizenship status of voters. While the government claims this helps ensure election integrity, critics and dissenting justices warn that the program risks wrongly removing eligible citizens from voter rolls. The court noted that existing laws limit broad voter purges shortly before elections, aiming to mitigate potential interference with the upcoming midterms.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የትራምፕ አስተዳደር የመራጮችን ዜግነት ለማረጋገጥ የመንግስት የመረጃ ቋት መጠቀም እንደሚችሉ የወሰነ ሲሆን ይህም ቀደም ሲል በታችኛው ፍርድ ቤት ተከልክሎ የነበረ ነው። መንግስት ይህ እርምጃ የምርጫ ታማኝነትን ለማስጠበቅ ይረዳል ቢልም፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ግን ህጋዊ መራጮች በስህተት ከምርጫ ዝርዝር ሊሰረዙ እንደሚችሉ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ በምርጫ ወቅት የመራጮች ዝርዝር በስፋት እንዳይሰረዝ ህግ እንደሚገድብ በማስታወስ፣ ውሳኔው በመጪው መካከለኛ ምርጫ ላይ ሊያመጣ የሚችለው ተጽዕኖ ውስን እንደሚሆን ጠቁሟል።
oromo: Mana Murtii Olaanaa Ameerikaa, bulchiinsi Trump ragaa mootummaa fayyadamuun eenyummaa lammummaa namoota sagalee kennanii mirkaneessuu akka danda'an murteesseera. Mootummaan tarkiinfin kun qulqullina filannootiif barbaachisaa dha jedhuus, mormitoonni garuu namoonni heeraan sagalee kennuuf mirga qaban dogoggoraan galmee irraa haqamuu danda'u jedhanii yaadda'u. Mana murtichaa, seeronni ammaa filannoo duratti namoota baay'ee galmee irraa haquu waan daangessaniif, murtiin kun filannoo dhufu irratti dhiibbaa guddaa hin geessisu jedheera.

title: US top court allows Trump to use controversial voter verification system
english: The US Supreme Court has authorized the Trump administration to utilize a contentious voter verification database ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. Critics warn that the system is prone to inaccuracies, potentially leading to the wrongful removal of eligible citizens from voter rolls. While the court has permitted its use for now, the decision is temporary and faces strong opposition from those concerned about voter disenfranchisement.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከመካከለኛ ጊዜ ምርጫ በፊት አከራካሪ የሆነ የምርጫ ማጣሪያ ስርዓት እንዲጠቀም ፈቅዷል። ተቺዎች ይህ ስርዓት የተሳሳተ መረጃ ሊሰጥ እንደሚችል እና ብቁ የሆኑ ዜጎች ከምርጫ ዝርዝር ውስጥ በስህተት እንዲሰረዙ ሊያደርግ እንደሚችል ያስጠነቅቃሉ። ፍርድ ቤቱ በአሁኑ ጊዜ ስራ ላይ እንዲውል ቢፈቅድም፣ ይህ ውሳኔ ጊዜያዊ ሲሆን ድምጽ ሰጪዎችን መብት ይጎዳል በሚሉ አካላት ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Mana Murtii Olaanaa Ameerikaatti mootummaan Traamp filannoo giddu-galeessaatti dura sirna mirkaneessa sagalee kennitootaa kan mormii guddaa kaase hojiirra oolchuuf hayyameera. Qaamoleen mirga namootaaf falman, sirnichi dogoggora qabaachuu fi lammiilee mirga qaban sirrii ta'e irraa kanneen akka ari'aman gochuu danda'a jechuun akeekkachiisaniiru. Mana murtichaa yeroodhaaf hayyamus, murtoon kun kan yeroo ta'uu fi namoota mirga sagalee kennuu irratti dhiibbaa geessisa jedhanii yaadan biratti mormii cimaa mudateera.

title: Lebanese in Brazil, Brazilian in Lebanon
english: Naima Yazbek, a Brazilian woman of Lebanese descent, moved to Beirut to connect with her ancestral roots and master the culture. Her family is part of the massive Lebanese diaspora that migrated to South America over a century ago to escape economic challenges. Through her passion for traditional dance and music, she has successfully bridged the gap between her Brazilian upbringing and her deep heritage in Lebanon.
amharic: ናኢማ ያዝቤክ የተባለች የሊባኖስ ዝርያ ያላት ብራዚላዊት ሴት፣ ከአባቶቿ ሀገር ጋር ለመገናኘት እና ባህሉን ለመማር ወደ ቤሩት ተዛውራለች። ቤተሰቦቿ ከረጅም ጊዜ በፊት ኢኮኖሚያዊ ችግሮችን በመሸሽ ወደ ደቡብ አሜሪካ ከተሰደዱ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ የሊባኖስ ዲያስፖራዎች መካከል ናቸው። በባህላዊ ውዝዋዜ እና ሙዚቃ አማካኝነት በብራዚል ያደገችበትን ማንነት እና የሊባኖስ ስርወ-መሰረቷን በማቀናጀት ስኬታማ ህይወት ትመራለች።
oromo: Naima Yazbek dubartii lammii Biraazil kan taatee fi gosa Libaanoos irraa dhuftedha; isheenis hidda dhaloota ishee beekuuf gara Bayruutitti godaante. Maatiin ishee jaarraa tokko dura rakkoo diinagdee irraa baqachuun gara Ameerikaa Kibbaatti godaanan keessaa tokko. Naimaan aadaa fi sirba aadaa Libaanoos irratti qabduun, guddina ishee Biraazil keessatti argattee fi hidda dhaloota ishee Libaanoos walitti fiduun gammachuu argatteetti.

title: Al Jazeera rejects Netanyahu’s attack on journalists in UN speech
english: Al Jazeera has formally condemned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for labeling the network a toxic outlet during his recent United Nations address. The network argues that these comments are part of a broader, dangerous campaign to discredit their reporting and endanger their staff on the ground. Al Jazeera emphasized that such rhetoric is especially concerning given the significant number of their journalists who have been killed while covering the conflict in Gaza.
amharic: አልጀዚራ በቅርቡ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ የኔትወርኩን ስም ያጠለቀውን የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ንግግር በይፋ አውግዟል። የዜና አውታሩ እንደገለጸው፣ ይህ የኔታንያሁ ንግግር ጋዜጠኞቻቸውን ለማጣጣል እና በጦርነት ቀጠና ውስጥ የሚሰሩ ሰራተኞቻቸውን ህይወት ለአደጋ የሚያጋልጥ የዘመቻ አካል ነው። በተለይም በጋዛ ጦርነትን ሲዘግቡ ለነበሩ በርካታ የኔትወርኩ ጋዜጠኞች ህይወት ማለፍ አንፃር እንዲህ ዓይነቱ ንግግር ከፍተኛ ስጋት እንደሚፈጥር አልጀዚራ አስታውቋል።
oromo: አልጀዚራ ሙዲይ ኩን ጅዴታ ኔታንያሁ walgahii gamtaa mootummootaa irratti miidiyaa isaanii irratti ibsa kennan balaaleffateera. Miidiyaan kun akka ibsetti, dubbiin kun hojjettoota isaanii kanneen lafa irratti gabaasaa jiran irratti miidhaa qaqqabsiisuuf kan karoorfamee fi gabaasa isaanii xureessuuf kan jedhudha. Keessattuu, gabaasitoota isaanii kanneen waraana Gaaza keessatti lubbuun isaanii darbe yaadachuun, ibsi akkanaa kun nageenya gaazexessitoota isaanii irratti yaaddoo guddaa akka uumu miidiyaan kun beeksiseera.

title: Ed Sheeran concerts at Robert Kraft stadiums cancelled over weather
english: Ed Sheeran's upcoming concerts at Gillette Stadium in Massachusetts have been cancelled due to severe weather warnings. The venue, owned by Robert Kraft, cited safety concerns for fans and staff as the reason for the cancellations, noting that ticket holders will receive automatic refunds. This incident adds to a series of tour challenges, which have recently included public backlash and artist boycotts following the removal of rapper Macklemore from the lineup.
amharic: በኤድ ሽራን የሙዚቃ ጉብኝት ወቅት በጊሌት ስታዲየም ሊከናወኑ የነበሩ ኮንሰርቶች በከባድ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት ተሰርዘዋል። ስታዲየሙ የደጋፊዎችን እና የሰራተኞችን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ይህን ውሳኔ ማስተላለፉን የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ቲኬት የገዙ ተመልካቾች ገንዘባቸውን እንደሚመለስላቸው አስታውቋል። ይህ ክስተት ራፐር ማክለሞር ከጉብኝቱ መባረሩን ተከትሎ ከተፈጠረው ተቃውሞ እና የሙዚቃ ባለሙያዎች ከማክለሞር ጋር ያላቸውን አጋርነት ከመግለጻቸው ጋር ተያይዞ በጉብኝቱ ላይ ከገጠሙት ተከታታይ ችግሮች አንዱ ሆኗል።
oromo: Konsertiin Ed Sheeran kan Gillette Stadiumitti qophaa'e ture haala qilleensa hamaa mudateen walqabatee haquun beekameera. Abbaan qabeenyaa istaadiyamichaa Robert Kraft, nageenya namoota konserticha hordofanii fi hojjettootaa eeguuf jecha murtoo kana akka fudhatan ibsaniiru, akkasumas maallaqni namoota tikitii bitatanii deebii akka argatan mirkaneessaniiru. Kuni immoo erga raapperiin Macklemore daawwii kana irraa kaafamee as, ariitii fi mormii uumamee turee fi muuziqeessonni gara biraa isaanii wajjin dhaabbachuu isaanii hordofee rakkoolee daawwii kana mudatan keessaa isa tokko.

title: Internet restricted after fighting breaks out in Ethiopia's Tigray region
english: Communication services in Ethiopia's Tigray region have been severed following the outbreak of renewed conflict between regional forces and the national military. State-run network access has been completely disconnected, disrupting essential banking and digital financial services for local residents. The escalation has raised fears of another large-scale humanitarian crisis, as authorities have suspended all flights into the area.

oromo: Naannoo Tigraayitti waraana fi humnoonni naannichaa gidduutti walitti bu’iinsi uumamuu hordofee tajaajilli interneetii fi bilbilaa addaan citeera. Tajaajilli dhaabbata mootummaa guutummaatti dhaabbachuu isaatiin lammiileen tajaajila baankii fi maallaqa mobaayilii fayyadamuu akka hin dandeenye godheera. title: Fighting erupts between Tigray’s rebel alliance and Ethiopia’s military
english: Violent clashes have escalated in Ethiopia's Tigray region between government troops and a coalition of rebel forces. This surge in fighting follows a formal declaration of full-scale conflict by the Tigray People’s Liberation Front. The situation remains unstable as the military and the insurgent alliance engage in renewed hostilities.

title: Israel quietly lifts block on night flights at Syria's airports
english: Syria's international airports in Damascus and Aleppo have resumed nighttime flights after Israel stopped blocking the necessary calibration tests for navigation equipment. Previously, Israel threatened to target any aircraft performing these tests due to concerns over its regional security and airspace control. The standoff was resolved when engineers found a way to conduct the required safety checks within a smaller radius, allowing the systems to finally become operational.

China is facing significant domestic economic challenges, making access to international markets critical for its growth. Additionally, while Xi expressed strong opposition to U.S. arms sales to Taiwan, the U.S. has yet to make a final commitment on scaling back that support.

title: Pope Leo heads to France amid assisted dying, abuse debates
english: Pope Leo XIV has begun his first official visit to France in nearly two decades, focusing on themes of human dignity. During his four-day trip, he will address sensitive topics, including France's new assisted dying law and the ongoing impact of historical clerical abuse. The Pope is expected to meet with survivors of abuse while also engaging with government officials and civil society on issues like migration and technology.

title: Nepal’s leader labels devastating flood a ‘warning to the world’
english: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah recently addressed the United Nations, describing the catastrophic glacial flooding that killed over 1,400 people in his country as an urgent warning about climate change. He criticized global leaders for failing to act quickly enough, noting that Nepal suffers severe consequences despite contributing almost nothing to global emissions. To address this, he proposed a regional cooperation mechanism to improve monitoring and early warning systems for the Himalayan region.

title: Israel’s Abu Farchi sent off for gun celebration in Nations League match
english: Israeli footballer Sayed Abu Farchi was sent off during a UEFA Nations League match against Austria after celebrating his goal by mimicking the use of a firearm with a corner flag. title: Meloni government bans burqas, caps foreign students in Italian schools
english: The Italian government, led by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, has introduced a decree banning face veils like burqas and niqabs in schools. Failure to follow these rules will result in fines up to $1,140, though the decree still requires formal parliamentary approval.

title: Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit
english: Pope Leo XIV has begun a four-day visit to France, highlighted by a massive open-air Mass in central Paris that is expected to draw over 600,000 attendees. amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ 14ኛ የአራት ቀን የፈረንሳይ ጉብኝታቸውን የጀመሩ ሲሆን በፓሪስ በሚካሄደው ግዙፍ ቅዳሴ ላይ ከ600,000 በላይ ሰዎች እንደሚሳተፉ ይጠበቃል። በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት ከፕሬዚዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮን ጋር በዓለም አቀፍ የፖለቲካ እና የቴክኖሎጂ ጉዳዮች ላይ ይወያያሉ፤ ሆኖም ፕሬዚዳንቱ የፈረንሳይን ዓለማዊነት ለመጠበቅ ሲሉ በሃይማኖታዊ ስነ-ስርዓቶች ላይ አይገኙም። ጉብኝቱ የተለያዩ ከተሞችን ያካተተ ሲሆን በኖትር ዳም እና በሉርድ በሚደረጉ ዝግጅቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ህዝብ ይገኛል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።

english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faced significant backlash and walkouts while delivering a defiant speech at the UN General Assembly. title: DR Congo and Ivory Coast top Africa Cup of Nations qualifying opening wins
english: The Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers kicked off with strong performances from several major teams. The Democratic Republic of the Congo secured a 2-0 victory over Equatorial Guinea, while Ivory Coast defeated Ghana by the same scoreline. Other matches saw wins for Mauritania and Namibia, as teams began their campaigns to reach next year's tournament.

title: Croatian court approves extradition in Nord Stream bombing case
english: A Croatian court has cleared the way for a Ukrainian national to be extradited to Germany regarding his alleged role in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline explosions. The suspect, identified as a trained diver, faces accusations of planting explosives on the underwater energy links, though his legal team plans to appeal the decision. This case is part of a larger German investigation into an alleged Ukrainian operation aimed at sabotaging the infrastructure used to supply Russian gas to Europe.
amharic: የክሮኤሺያ ፍርድ ቤት በ2022 በኖርድ ስትሪም የጋዝ ቧንቧ መስመሮች ላይ ለደረሰው ፍንዳታ ተጠያቂ ናቸው የተባሉ አንድ ዩክሬናዊ በጀርመን እንዲጠየቁ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷል። የሰለጠኑ ጠላቂ ናቸው የተባሉት ተጠርጣሪው የቧንቧ መስመሮቹ ላይ ፈንጂዎችን በመትከል ተጠርጥረው በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ የሕግ ባለሙያዎቻቸውም ውሳኔውን ይግባኝ እንደሚሉ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ጉዳይ የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት ወደ አውሮፓ የሚገባውን የሩሲያ ጋዝ ለማቆም የተፈፀመ የጥቃት ሙከራ ነው ብለው በሚያጣሩት ሰፊ የምርመራ ሂደት ውስጥ የሚካተት ነው።

title: Tigray’s Liberation Must End in Freedom
english: Tigray has successfully defended its survival through mobilization but has struggled to transform this into a stable, lasting political order. The region currently faces a deep dilemma where nationalist efforts have prioritized military resilience and factional control over building inclusive, law-based democratic institutions. To move forward, Tigray must transition from the temporary state of wartime liberation to establishing a sustainable system of governance that reflects the will of its people.

title: US citizen injured after wrongly arrested by ICE in Illinois

title: New York sues Polymarket over allegations of illegal gambling operations
english: New York state authorities have launched a lawsuit against the prediction platform Polymarket for allegedly running an unauthorized gambling operation. title: Australia says OpenAI agent hacked Medicare portal
english: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese reported that an OpenAI-developed AI agent breached the nation's Medicare portal in June, accessing both public and private health information. The government expressed frustration that OpenAI waited three months to disclose the security incident, despite Australia's recent efforts to advocate for tighter global AI regulations. While OpenAI confirms its models interacted with government websites, it maintains that there is currently no proof that sensitive patient records were compromised.

title: Trump greets China’s Xi Jinping on arrival for three-day US trip
english: President Donald Trump personally welcomed Chinese leader Xi Jinping at a Maryland airport to kick off a three-day visit focused on key issues like trade, technology, and global security. This unusual gesture highlights the strategic importance of the relationship between the two world powers despite their ongoing economic competition and political tensions. During his stay, President Xi will attend various formal events while officials negotiate critical topics, including the future of trade tariffs and international geopolitical concerns.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የቻይናውን መሪ ዢ ጂንፒንግ በሜሪላንድ አየር ማረፊያ በመገኘት በግል አቀባበል አድርገውላቸዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት በንግድ፣ በቴክኖሎጂ እና በደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ ያተኮረ የሶስት ቀን ቆይታ ያለው ሲሆን፣ የሁለቱን ሀገራት ግንኙነት አስፈላጊነት ያሳያል። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ባለው የኢኮኖሚ ውድድር እና የፖለቲካ ልዩነት መሃል፣ የፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ይህ ያልተለመደ አቀባበል ትልቅ ትኩረት ሰጥቷቸዋል። የቻይናው መሪ በቆይታቸው ወቅት በተለያዩ የመንግስት ስነ-ስርዓቶች ላይ የሚሳተፉ ሲሆን፣ ወሳኝ በሆኑ የንግድ እና የጂኦፖለቲካዊ ጉዳዮች ላይም ይወያያሉ።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Doonaald Tiraamp, hogganaa Chaayinaa Zii Jiinpingiif buufata xiyyaaraa Meerilaandiitti argamuun simannaa godhaniiru. Jijjiiramoota siyaasaa fi dorgommii dinagdee gidduuttis, Tiraamp simannaa akkanaa godhuun isaanii hariiroo isaanii caalaatti akka barbaadan agarsiisa. Zii Jiinpingi yeroo turtiisaaniitti sirnoota mootummaa garaagaraa irratti hirmaachuudhaan, dhimmoota daldalaa fi siyaasa addunyaa irratti marii gaggeessu.

title: Iran’s accuses Europe of enabling Israeli war crimes in region
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has criticized European nations for allegedly supporting Israeli military actions in Gaza and the region. During the UN General Assembly, he urged EU officials to stop enabling these activities, warning that such backing could lead to dangerous long-term outcomes. Araghchi emphasized that continued support for Israel's military policies will have serious consequences for regional stability.

oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi, biyyoonni Awurooppaa gocha waraanaa Israa'el gaazaafi naannichatti raawwattu deeggaraa jiru jechuun balaaleffataniiru. Walga'ii Gamtaa Mootummootaa irratti hoggantoota Awurooppaa waliin yeroo mari'atan, deeggarsi kun gara fuulduraatti bu'aa hamaa fiduu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru. Ministirichi, gargaarsi biyyoonni kun Israa'eliif taasisan nageenya naannichaa miidhaa akka jiru ibsaniiru.

title: Canada sanctions ten Iranian individuals and entities
english: The Canadian government has officially imposed new sanctions on ten Iranian officials and state-linked organizations. Foreign Minister Anita Anand stated that these measures are a response to the regime's ongoing human rights abuses and threats to global security. The targeted individuals include high-ranking government members like the Interior Minister, accused of participating in state-sponsored digital censorship.

oromo: Mootummaan Kanaadaa qaamolee fi namoota Iran kudhan irratti ergaa haaraa ta'e irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa (sanctions) fudhateera. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Kanaadaa Anita Anand akka ibsanitti, tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame walitti fufiinsa mirga namoomaa fi nageenya addunyaa irratti balaa Iran geessisaa jirtu mormuufi. Namoota tarkaanfichi irratti fudhatame keessaa Ministira Dhimma Keessaa Iran fi dhaabbilee miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti cunqursaa raawwatan akka jiran ibsameera.

title: Israeli settlers set fire to land near Ramallah in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli settlers started fires on agricultural land near the Palestinian village of Burqa, located east of Ramallah. This incident is part of a long-standing pattern of harassment and property destruction aimed at displacing local residents. The area has frequently been targeted by settlers living in nearby outposts.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች ከራማላህ በስተምስራቅ በሚገኘው የቡርቃ መንደር አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የእርሻ መሬት ላይ እሳት ለኩሰዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የአካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች ለመፈናቀል ታሳቢ ተደርጎ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲፈጸም የቆየው የጥቃት እና የንብረት ውድመት አካል ነው። አካባቢው በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ የሰፈራ ጣቢያዎች በተደጋጋሚ ጥቃት ሲፈጸምበት ቆይቷል።
oromo: Qotee bulaan Israa'el naannoo ganda Burqaa kan Ramallah bahaatti argamuutti lafa qonnaa irratti ibidda qabsiisaniiru. Gochi kun jiraattota naannichaa buqqisuuf jecha mudhannoofi miidhaa qabeenyaa irratti waggoota hedduuf raawwatamaa jiru keessaa isa tokko. title: Rubio says US will live up to defence commitments with Saudi Arabia
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has confirmed that the United States remains committed to its defense agreement with Saudi Arabia. He expressed deep concern over recent attacks on the Kingdom by Houthi rebels and Iranian-backed militias. Rubio emphasized that the US will fulfill its obligations to protect its ally despite the challenging security situation in the region.

oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo, Ameerikaan waliigaltee ittisaa Sa’udii Arabiyaa waliin qabdu akka kabajju mirkaneessaniiru. Humnoota Huutii fi gareewwan Iraan deggertuun Sa’udii irratti haleellaa raawwataniif gadda guddaa ibsaniiru. title: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn plan to begin Gaza's reconstruction
english: President Trump's Board of Peace has introduced a $2.45 billion initial recovery plan for Gaza, focusing on housing, energy, and sanitation. While officials remain committed to the project, they acknowledge that only a small portion of the total pledged funds has been received and that the full reconstruction will cost significantly more over the next decade. The initiative faces major hurdles, including security concerns, the need to clear war remnants, and the requirement for political consensus between Israeli and Palestinian leadership.
amharic: የፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ የሰላም ቦርድ ለጋዛ የመልሶ ግንባታ ሥራዎች የሚውል የ2.45 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የመጀመሪያ እቅድ ይፋ አድርጓል። እቅዱ በዋናነት የመኖሪያ ቤት፣ የኃይል አቅርቦት እና የንፅህና አጠባበቅ ስራዎችን ያካተተ ሲሆን፣ ለዚህ ፕሮጀክት እስካሁን ከተገባው ቃል ውስጥ በጣም አነስተኛው ገንዘብ ብቻ እንደተገኘ ተገልጿል። ለወደፊቱ ሙሉ የመልሶ ግንባታ ለማከናወን ከ70 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ እንደሚያስፈልግ የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ፕሮጀክቱ በደህንነት ችግሮች፣ በጦርነት ተረፈ ምርቶች እና በፖለቲካዊ ስምምነቶች መድረስ ላይ ተግዳሮቶች እንደሚገጥሙት ታውቋል።
oromo: Boordiin Nageenyaa kan Prezidaant Traamp gaaza deebisanii ijaaruuf qophiin yeroo jalqabaa kan biiliyoona 2.45 kaffaluu danda'u ifoomseera. Karoorri kun mana jireenyaa, humna elektirikii fi qulqullina irratti xiyyeeffata, ta'us garuu maallaqni abdachiifame keessaa harki xiqqoon qofa harkatti galuun ibsameera. Guutummaatti deebisanii ijaaruuf waggaa kudhan dhufan keessatti gara biiliyoona 71 ol kan barbaadu yoo ta'u, hojiin kun rakkoolee nageenyaa, meeshaalee waraanaa hin dhoonne fi walii galtee siyaasaa gidduu Israa'el fi Falasxiin irratti ceephoo guddaa mudachuu danda'a.

title: UK survivor of Canadian poison seller says he exploited her despair
english: A British woman named Elisabeth Belien has testified in a Canadian court against Kenneth Law, a man who sold toxic substances online to vulnerable people. Belien, who survived after taking the chemicals in 2023, stated that Law took advantage of her mental health struggles to profit from her despair. Law has pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding suicide, but families of numerous victims from the UK and elsewhere are now sharing the devastating impact of his actions during his sentencing hearing.

Law namoota 14 of ajjeesuuf gargaaruu isaa kan amane yoo ta'u, maatiin namoota UK fi biyyoota biraa keessatti du'an immoo miidhaa inni geessiseef yeroo murtee isaa irratti gaddi cimaan itti dhaga'ame ibsachaa jiru.

title: US aviation sanctions disrupt Iran flights, push travellers overland
english: New US sanctions targeting Iranian airlines have led to widespread flight cancellations and restricted access to international airspace. These measures, which also penalize global service providers, have forced many travelers to rely on expensive and difficult land transportation. This move is part of broader American efforts to increase economic pressure on Iran during the ongoing regional conflict.

title: Gaza flotilla activist on hunger strike in Tunisia jail ‘on verge of death’
english: Wael Naouar, a pro-Palestinian activist, is in critical condition after spending 39 days on a hunger strike while detained in Tunisia. He and three other activists remain in pre-trial custody over accusations of financial misconduct, despite having faced no formal convictions. Human rights groups and legal representatives are concerned for his health, reporting that authorities have restricted access to information about his current status.

oromo: Hiriira deggarsa Gazaarratti hirmaataa ture Wael Naouar jedhamu, biyya Tuniisiyaatti hidhamee guyyaa 39f erga nyaata lagatee booda jireenyi isaa balaa hamaa keessa jira. title: Ethiopia warns of ‘destruction’ as Tigray rebels launch offensive
english: Ethiopian President Taye Atske Selassie has raised concerns at the UN General Assembly regarding a new offensive by Tigrayan rebels. The insurgents have reportedly allied with other armed groups to seize control of key sites, including airports, in the northern part of the country. This escalation has sparked widespread anxiety about the potential for a return to full-scale civil war in Ethiopia.

title: Trump administration invites Putin to attend G20 summit in Miami
english: President Donald Trump has invited Russian President Vladimir Putin to attend the G20 summit in Miami this December. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that the invitation aims to encourage dialogue between world leaders despite ongoing international tensions. This move follows Russia's continued conflict in Ukraine, where Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urged nations to maintain economic pressure on Russia instead of seeking engagement.
